Chapter 7105: Big Business

Chapter 7105: Big Business

“So be it, since it has nothing to do with me, you deal with it.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Wait, wait, old man, are you still human?” He stomped in frustration.

“Of course, but this isn’t any of my business, I’m sure you got this.” Li Qiye said while leaving.

“Shit, I can’t handle all my things even if I have a thousand hands or clones.” He complained.

“Oh? I didn’t know you were so considerate of others, young master.” Li Qiye cupped his fist.

“I’m not heartless like you, I am mustering all of my strength and resources to help Heavenly Desolace get through the calamity.” He said.

“Is that the whole story?” Li Qiye asked.

“What else can it be? My heart is full of love, I’m not a bastard like you.” He said.

“Still a little bastard right now, not a full-fledged one yet.” Li Qiye said.

“You!” He nearly vomited blood.

Li Qiye chuckled and patted his shoulder: “The calamity is a good opportunity, take those bolts and imprint them into Heavenly Desolace to be used as energy sources.”

“How do you know?!” He became startled.

“Ginger gets spicier with time, don’t act all mysterious when you’re at a low level.” Li Qiye said.

“Hmph, that’s just an incidental win. If we can do this right, we can block all the tribulations.” He said.

“It’s possible.” Li Qiye smiled.

“We have measured Heavenly Desolace, it’s more than just possible.” He said.

“Sure thing.” Li Qiye nodded.

“Old man, are you really just going to watch without doing anything?” He asked.

“It’s all within karma.” Li Qiye said.

“This bullshit karma.” He shouted: “My fate is mine, the villainous heaven does not get to decide!”

“What if I’m the villainous heaven?” Li Qiye asked.

“...” He couldn’t respond for a second: “Then I will rebel, you’re not special.”

“Indeed.” Li Qiye laughed.

“I’m sure you have said the same line before when your blood boiled with passion, that you would take down the villainous heaven.” He said.

Li Qiye didn’t respond.

“Old man, are you becoming the thing you hate the most?” He asked: “You want to replace the villainous heaven?”

“You tell me.” Li Qiye said.

“I don’t know anymore. You’re not a coward that would stop halfway.” He said.

“Then why are you here talking nonsense?” Li Qiye asked.

“I’m just spouting whatever is on my mind, don’t mind me.” He said.

“You told him about the sea of wisdom last time too.” Li Qiye said.

“It was a complete success last time, a triumphant return.” He said.

“What more do you know?” Li Qiye asked.

“I told you everything.” He waved.

“Then why did you tell him to go again, out of all places?” Li Qiye asked.

“The scenery is good, no people either. He’ll comprehend something else on a second trip.” He said.

“Really now?” Li Qiye smirked again.

“Of course.” He said.

“Have you been there before?” Li Qiye asked.

“No, such a long way on top of being in a crappy world.” He shook his head.

“Didn’t you say the scenery is good?” Li Qiye said.

“Old man, you know we are similar, virtually one with heaven and earth. I just needed a moment and sensed it, that’s why I felt that place was suitable for Black Dragon.” He defended himself.

“I suppose if you felt this way, Black Dragon should be fine.” Li Qiye said.

“Well...” He smiled wryly: “Because of my business, I know a lot of people and have access to information.”

“What information?” Li Qiye asked.

“I will say that Divine Firmament will have a new leader soon.” He said.

“Is that surprising? Just a change in leadership, utterly trivial since I can create worlds now.” Li Qiye didn’t care.

“It’s not as simple as just a change in leadership. Certain forces are returning and can reduce Divine Firmament to dust.” He said.

“So confident?” Li Qiye asked.

“Yes, a businessman requires fast and accurate information to avoid big losses.” He smiled wryly.

“Is that all? Not actively being involved?” Li Qiye asked.

“Well, I can’t be sure since we have so many customers and deals each day.” He said, feeling his scalp tingling due to Li Qiye’s piercing glare.

“Alright, fine, I did a small deal.” He spilled out the truth.
